extracted.intended_audience: Goodreads users (readers, authors, community members, and moderators)
extracted.subtask_description: Platform-specific community guidelines for participating on Goodreads: posting reviews, comments, images, and interacting with other members while preserving a welcoming space and following feature-specific policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain a welcoming space / respectful interactions
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep Goodreads a welcoming place where people can come together to share reviews, participate in discussions, and enjoy interacting with readers and authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consider the impact of your contributions on individuals and the community before jumping in. Respectful, lively debates are encouraged. If a conversation is deteriorating, you can opt to disengage. Simply put, add value to the community—don’t diminish it.

rubrics_metrics.name: No hate speech, bigotry, threats, or ad hominem attacks
rubrics_metrics.description: Hate speech, bigotry, threats, and ad hominem attacks are not tolerated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criticizing the opinions of others is permitted, but attacking individuals for their opinions is not.

rubrics_metrics.name: No spam or self-promotional content
rubrics_metrics.description: Spam and self-promotional content are prohibited; abusing Goodreads features to promote yourself or your product detracts from the experience of others and breaks our rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors can check Author Guidelines for specific information on how to interact with readers and use Goodreads. Avoid behavior that is primarily promotional or uses features to push products/services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post original content; no plagiarism or copyright infringement
rubrics_metrics.description: Goodreads supports original, creative contributions. Plagiarism and copyright infringement are not allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where you can add content, go for it—just make sure it belongs to you.

rubrics_metrics.name: Image content restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: You are welcome to post images, but images containing nudity, sexually-explicit content, or graphic violence are not allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not post images that include prohibited explicit or graphic content; follow this when adding visual material to reviews, profiles, or discussions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentic identity and account integrity
rubrics_metrics.description: Bring your authentic self to Goodreads. Please don’t misrepresent your identity or create accounts to harass other members, abuse features, or evade our rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Spammers and scammers are not welcome. Do not create duplicate/fake accounts to avoid moderation or to harass others.

rubrics_metrics.name: No manipulation of ratings or reputation
rubrics_metrics.description: Artificially inflating or deflating a book’s ratings or reputation violates our rules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prohibited activities include creating fake accounts to manipulate book ratings, purchasing reviews, and incentivizing votes, likes, or other actions on Goodreads. Such behavior diminishes community trust and is not tolerated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report violations; let staff handle enforcement
rubrics_metrics.description: If you see content that breaks our rules, report it or contact us.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Don’t take it upon yourself to correct other people’s bad behavior, and don’t encourage bad behavior by acknowledging it. Staff members evaluate each flagged item, typically within 72 hours, and take action to educate members about our rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disengage from deteriorating conversations
rubrics_metrics.description: If a conversation is deteriorating, you can opt to disengage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users are encouraged not to escalate conflicts; disengaging is preferred over attempting to police or correct others publicly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Add value; don’t diminish the community
rubrics_metrics.description: Contributions should add value to the community; do not diminish it.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you adore books and treat others with respect, you help maintain the community’s quality and welcome environment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Platform reserves right to remove content
rubrics_metrics.description: Goodreads reserves the right to remove content at any time for any reason.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Moderation and removal are at Goodreads’ sole discretion to decide when content violates guidelines; users should be aware content may be removed even if not explicitly enumerated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Member opinions are individual, not endorsements
rubrics_metrics.description: The content posted on Goodreads contains individual and subjective opinions. The opinions expressed are those of Goodreads members and not of Goodreads.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Goodreads does not endorse member opinions; this clarifies responsibility for posted content lies with the member.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow feature-specific guidelines where applicable
rubrics_metrics.description: Different parts of the site have their own additional guidelines and terms (e.g., Group Moderator Guidelines, Rating and Review Guidelines, Author Guidelines, Q&A Guidelines, Catalog Guidelines).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When interacting in groups, asking/answering Q&A, posting reviews, or moderating, consult the relevant specialized guideline documents for more detailed rules and expectations.
